# mtncloud_network_subnets (Data Source)

Lists your subnets, including those made in the console. Subnets of your networks.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Only those whose name matches; leave name_regex out to list them all.
data "mtncloud_network_subnets" "all" {
  name_regex = "^app-"
}

output "network_subnets" {
  value = { for x in data.mtncloud_network_subnets.all.network_subnets : x.id => { name = x.name, cidr = x.cidr } }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name_regex` (String) Only return subnets whose name matches this regular expression (RE2 syntax), for example `^web-`.

### Read-Only

- `network_subnets` (Attributes List) The subnets, sorted by name, then ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network_subnets))

<a id="nestedatt--network_subnets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `network_subnets`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the subnet is active.
- `cidr` (String) IPv4 CIDR.
- `cloud` (String) Cloud the subnet is in.
- `description` (String) Description, or empty.
- `dhcp` (Boolean) Whether DHCP is on.
- `dns_primary` (String) Primary DNS server.
- `dns_secondary` (String) Secondary DNS server.
- `gateway` (String) Gateway.
- `id` (Number) ID of the subnet.
- `name` (String) Name of the subnet.
- `netmask` (String) Netmask.
- `network` (String) Network the subnet is in.
- `network_id` (Number) ID of that network.
- `status` (String) Status.
